tasks.context: on a team-level, such as a team that is planning an annual event with multiple tasks, deadlines, and departments
tasks.span: tracking shared tasks on a team-level, such as a team that is planning an annual event with multiple tasks, deadlines, and departments (marketing and sponsorships, event logistics, registration management, etc.)

tasks.object: each task as an agenda item
tasks.span: check off each task as an agenda item

tasks.object: an agenda item into a task on someone's to-do list
tasks.span: turn an agenda item into a task on someone's to-do list, adding a due date and moving the task to a relevant project

benefits.claim: It can work wonders for your team if you know how to use all its features.
benefits.span: If you know how to use Asana and all of its features, then it can work wonders for your team.

benefits.claim: Tasks can be assigned to as few or as many teammates as preferred.
benefits.span: Tasks can be assigned to as few or as many teammates as you'd prefer

benefits.claim: Tasks can be moved between sub-categories and projects.
benefits.span: Tasks can move between sub-categories and between projects.

frictions.claim: The functionality and innerworkings can be rather complex for a team's comprehension.
frictions.span: the functionality and innerworkings of Asana can be rather complex for a team's comprehension.

frictions.claim: It can be challenging if you have already created an Asana account with one email while representing multiple organizations.
frictions.span: it can also be challenging if you have already created an Asana account with one email.

frictions.claim: It is difficult to merge all Asana 'teams' into one log-in if you have already created a log-in.
frictions.span: it is difficult to do so if you have already created an Asana log-in.
